entries.subject: DAMIT 290: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-290.txt. Model 290, version 2011-02-11, pole (103°, 43°), period 14.84547 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 148 ±25 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal diameter as an alternative scale
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the selected archive model has a physical size calibration. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 121.96 ± 1.19 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 68 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-specific comparison with the selected shape and physical calibration justifies changing the adopted scale.

entries.subject: Resolved-model surveys: body-specific candidate not established
entries.finding: The imported survey cites Hanuš 2017, Viikinkoski 2017 and Vernazza 2021 without identifying a selected product for this body. The current DAMIT reference join does not bind selected model 290 to those surveys. This does not prove that no resolved model exists elsewhere; a body-specific candidate and its release must be identified before the entry can count as included.
entries.revisitWhen: A target row, supplementary model or release URL from one of these surveys establishes a concrete candidate and permits comparison with the selected shape.

entries.subject: Hanuš et al. 2018
entries.finding: [Hanuš et al. 2018](https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06116) and [occultation dimensions](https://www.asteroidoccultation.com/observations/Asteroid_Dimensions_from_Occultations.html) — size comparison candidates; an independent fit or occultation ellipsoid is not silently equated with this mesh’s volume.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The release supplies no registered surface imagery; the grid marks that gap.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: The survey found no alternative archive solution for this target.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
